promotion_rule: Do not set RETRIEVAL_TESTED or VERIFIED until every required case is executed through the production retrieval interface, the governed repository PDF copy hashes to the recorded SHA-256, the full section/rule/source-span audit is complete, and all canonical dependency targets required for traversal are mapped.
